findings.detail: The helper now requires retainFailure and records original error name/message/stack/code, exact journey/step and before-step/action/after-step/certificate phase plus URL/diagnostics privately before attempting DOM or PNG. A failed later screenshot/DOM capture cannot erase the initial error receipt.

Console/pageerror/failed-request/response diagnostics are bounded by event count and text length, written only through the existing new-M private recorder. DOM and PNG capture attempts have bounded deadlines, with captured failures retained privately. Public report receives only fixed category/phase and an explicit allowlisted private file/bytes/hash reference, never the returned arbitrary error/evidence object.

Linux entries supply the private failure hook with current source case/PG/index metadata. They preserve the original failed observation and its receipts instead of throwing a second generic observed!=fail assertion. Only a truly observed result may enter the existing stopped-writers/observer-restore/drain/double-zero success path.

Full diffs leave actual UI business actions/assertions, exact source scopes, real HTTP routing, SDK/PG certification, fixtures and product guards unchanged. Existing complete-source capsule, browser environment and owner protections still apply. Synthetic metadata test confirms the existing auth-only project scope shape and rejection of unproven explicit sales anchors; it is not a loosened sales guard.

Added page diagnostic listeners are removed in finally. Cancellation retains stopped/fail status, original private failures and the existing independently closed owned resources; diagnostics do not certify an actual UI result.
